CURRENT QUESTION:
only Gaya Nalanda and years 2022-2023. calculate delivery coverage and postnatal coverage over registrations
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH delivery_coverage AS (
  SELECT
    district,
    year,
    (
      CAST(institutional_deliveries AS REAL) / NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0)
    ) * 100 AS delivery_coverage
  FROM maternal_services
  WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda')
    AND year IN (2022, 2023)
), postnatal_coverage AS (
  SELECT
    district,
    year,
    (
      CAST(postnatal_check_48h AS REAL) / NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0)
    ) * 100 AS postnatal_coverage
  FROM maternal_services
  WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda')
    AND year IN (2022, 2023)
)
SELECT
  delivery_coverage.district,
  delivery_coverage.year,
  delivery_coverage.delivery_coverage,
  postnatal_coverage.postnatal_coverage
FROM delivery_coverage
JOIN postnatal_coverage
  ON delivery_coverage.district = postnatal_coverage.district
  AND delivery_coverage.year = postnatal_coverage.year
```
